what: Spec gate round 1: the sweep scoped run-wide replacement Thens but left a bare whole-file unchanged Then in twelve scenarios, which the suite reads as the final state and an approved offer of the other addition would contradict. Swept every bare instance; each now asserts the section its Given names is byte-identical. The scenario map row for the owner-says-theirs path was brought in line with its scoped Given.

Spec gate round 2 found that scoping whole-file Thens to one section, the round-1 fix, dropped the only check that a run offering nothing writes nothing, and missed three until-answered Thens. Regression of the round-1 fix, so re-planned rather than patched: every whole-file Then is restored as frozen and the Given settles the other addition instead, by holding its current text or by scoping to the run only offer or question. Then references made ambiguous by the added Given line now name their section.

Spec gate round 3: the sweep missed an offer-display scenario whose Then said the offer shows the existing section, which the other addition offer cannot meet. Swept every Then naming an unqualified offer; the replacement-display and verbatim-offer Thens now name the Delegation offer. Iteration cap of three reached; one confirmation round run on this mechanical fix rather than auto-accepting.

Spec gate confirmation round: one more unqualified-offer Then in the root-path scenario disagreed with the node rule. It now asserts the destination for each offer, which covers both additions without weakening the claim.

Spec gate round 1 for issue 157: naming the global file made a barred scenario's Then, that no offer names a file outside the agent configuration, contradict the new destination scenario in one run. Narrowed that Then to files inside the repository, one frozen scenario beyond the ratified set, flagged for the owner. Also fixed the detection count, stated the documents-none harness case, made a conditional Then boolean, and recorded two out-of-scope provenance cases as a follow-up.

Spec gate round 2 for issue 157: the destination-neutral root-path Then said any AGENTS.md an offer names, which the global destination also matches; scoped it to a repository AGENTS.md. The duplicate report now appears on the already-current graph node, the already-global Then says the owner may ask for the copy, its Given isolates an uncovered file, restated default Givens were dropped, and the team-copy Then no longer re-asserts the managed-region rule.

Spec gate round 3 for issue 157 found a regression of the round-1 fix: making the already-global Then say no section is written failed a correct run in which the owner asks for the team copy inside the same run. Re-planned to the suite's own form for a pending answer, the file unchanged until the owner asks. Also made the already-global test the full already-current test, stated which text the Givens mean, and scoped the silent-Given rule per addition. The iteration cap of three is reached; one confirmation round follows.

Spec gate confirmation round for issue 157: the already-global scenario's whole-file Then did not settle the other addition in its Given, as the node rule requires, so an approved List identifiers offer in the same run could fail it. Added the standard Given line. Also aligned the Surface sentence and the already-global diagram nodes with the suite.

Spec gate second confirmation for issue 157 passed every scenario; the one blocking finding was the entry-point outcome still promising an offer for every uncovered addition. Updated that outcome and the invoking-agent goal for the already-global state, softened a competing superlative, keyed the already-global prose to the merged view, and tied the team-copy Given to the run's own statement.
